events.boundary: A funding path does not establish actor identity.

events.description: Bitquery places the first included outflow on the XRP Ledger at 20:04 UTC; TRM uses approximately 20:05 UTC.
events.boundary: The one-minute difference is preserved rather than collapsed.

events.description: A public Ethereum node returns a successful transaction and receipt in block 26300770 with 64 logs.
events.boundary: The observation is not a decoded incident total or actor attribution.

events.description: Bitquery reports a World Liberty token freeze at 20:57 UTC, followed by Tether and Circle actions at 21:01 and 21:04 UTC.
events.boundary: Freeze totals depend on asset, authority, address state and cutoff.

events.description: Bitquery records a withdrawal pause at approximately 22:33 UTC based on press reports.
events.boundary: This packet did not capture the original pause notice with an exact timestamp.

events.description: Bitquery and TRM describe later Ethereum activity through 23:56 UTC.
events.boundary: This is the end of the reviewed analyst window, not proof of no later incident-related movement.

events.description: Bitquery reports the relevant Ethereum authorization was revoked at 00:10:35 UTC.
events.boundary: The revocation transaction was not independently queried in this candidate.

events.description: Bitquery reports that Arbitrum's Security Council moved affected assets into a locked wallet.
events.boundary: Rescued and frozen are tracked separately from recovered, returned and compensated.

events.description: Binance publishes its initial incident account, around USD 6.3B estimated impact, around USD 3B frozen, a compensation promise and future-report commitments.
events.boundary: Operator statement; post-mortem and updated proof of reserves still pending.

events.description: Bitquery publishes a nine-chain analysis with transaction identifiers and an approximately USD 2.7B frozen estimate; TRM separately publishes a ten-chain USD 6.36B analysis and attribution judgment.
events.boundary: Analytic agreement on scale does not erase chain-count, cutoff, methodology or attribution differences.

events.description: StructEvidence freezes this candidate with reserve, root-cause, attribution, freeze-reconciliation and compensation gaps open.
events.boundary: No publication, solvency conclusion or external action is authorized.

decision_gap.question: Does public evidence establish that user liabilities were fully covered after the incident and that promised compensation was completed?
closure_tests: Capture the original pre-incident proof-of-reserves audit time, Merkle root, address bundle and asset/liability table with hashes.
Reconcile incident outflows, issuer freezes, protocol rescues, recoveries, returns and compensation without double counting.
Capture the promised post-remediation proof-of-reserves snapshot and technical post-mortem.
Reproduce material chain balances at declared cutoffs using public nodes and documented address-label provenance.
Obtain independently reviewable liability scope and exclusions; proof of assets alone does not close the test.
Record evidence of completed user restoration rather than relying on a promise.
decision_gap.prohibited_inference: No solvency, insolvency, safety, negligence, criminal or actor conclusion may be derived from the current open state.
